subject: Shift: Boxing Week customer demos — holiday coverage & escalation plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Elise Porter <elise@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Nate Brown <nate.brown@resellco.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Shift: Boxing Week customer demos — holiday coverage & escalation plan

Hi all — quick heads-up. Leadership confirmed a company-wide winter shutdown from Dec 26–Jan 2 this year. That window overlaps several booked demo slots for MapleHealth (DEAL-8731) and a handful of other prospects.

Attaching the internal playbook and a calendar with suggested alternative slots. For MapleHealth specifically: the demo is currently booked for Thu Dec 30 10:00 AM CET (we were accommodating their APAC team). Given the shutdown, we need either to:

- Move their main demo to the week of Jan 11 (preferred for capacity), or
- Offer an early backup on Wed Dec 23 (short window before holiday travel) if they need an exec present.

Action items: Lauren — can you own the outreach on MapleHealth and propose the two options below? Marcus — please identify coverage for Jan 11 (engineer + solutions SME). Monica — I’ll coordinate calendars and update the support rotation.

Elise / Nate — apologies for the churn. We want to avoid any dropped momentum; please let us know if Dec 23 is strictly impossible on your side. Otherwise we’ll pencil Jan 11 and hold Dec 23 as a backup.

Attachments: boxing-week-coverage-playbook.pdf, Q4-demo-slots.ics

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Elise Porter <elise@maplehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shift: Boxing Week customer demos — holiday coverage & escalation plan

On Thu, 19 Nov 2026 at 09:12, Soojin Lee wrote:
> Hi all — quick heads-up. Leadership confirmed a company-wide winter shutdown from Dec 26–Jan 2 this year...

Thanks, Soojin. I’ll reach out to Elise now with two concrete slots:
- Wed Dec 23 10:00 AM CET (backup)
- Mon Jan 11 02:00 PM CET (primary)

I’ll flag that the Jan 11 slot will include our senior infra engineer (Marcus) and a short 15-minute architecture addendum from Monica if they want it.

Elise — will either slot work on your side? If you confirm Jan 11 I’ll send updated invites and mark the Dec 23 slot as tentative.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
From: Elise Porter <elise@maplehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Shift: Boxing Week customer demos — holiday coverage & escalation plan

Hi Lauren / Soojin — thanks for the heads-up. Quick constraints from our side: CFO will be travelling the week of Jan 4–8, so Jan 6–7 are out. Dec 23 is actually preferable for our execs if you can make 10:00 AM CET — it’s the only contiguous time before a lot of our folks break for travel.

Two notes:
- If Dec 23 is feasible please keep the session tight (45 min) — we primarily want to validate performance/costs for our batch workloads.
- If Dec 23 ends up not working on Redwood’s side, Jan 11 should be fine for us.

Apologies for the short notice — happy to confirm once Lauren sends a formal invite.

Best,
Elise Porter
Head of Procurement, MapleHealth
elise@maplehealth.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Elise Porter <elise@maplehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shift: Boxing Week customer demos — holiday coverage & escalation plan

Thanks for the update. Plan from infra/ops:
- We can support a 45-minute focused demo on Wed Dec 23 10:00 AM CET (Marcus + solutions SME available).
- We’ll also reserve Mon Jan 11 02:00 PM CET as the primary expanded session (60–75 min) with extra time for a deep dive and post-demo perf tests.

Next steps: Lauren to send two invites (Dec 23 tentative, Jan 11 confirmed). Monica to update the rotation and mark the on-call bench for Dec 23 in case of live troubleshooting. I’ll add DEAL-8731 notes to the HubSpot record and attach the small perf checklist to both invites.

Thanks — I’ll be on the call for both.
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
